current_date: 10 June 2021 (Cabinet decision to publish and use the Planning Local Validation List; took effect 17 June 2021)
current_evidence: The Lewes Cabinet decision of 10/06/2021 (democracy.lewes-eastbourne.gov.uk, AIId=8609) agreed 'the publication and use of Planning Local Validation List contained at Appendix 1 and 2'. The Apply for planning permission page still points LDC applicants to 'the local validation list below' and shows no date. Searches found no later Lewes list, but the PDFs (media/2923 and media/2927) returned client_error, so I could not confirm that the page links these exact files.

issues.detail: The source list could not be fetched. Both Grokbot's workbook URL (media/2927 Appendix PDF) and the main list PDF (media/2923) failed with client_error, and the Apply for planning permission page shows link text but no document URLs. The findings below come from the decision record, the Cabinet report and Grokbot's own extracted excerpts, not from reading the list itself.
issues.evidence: WebFetch: 'failed at its site (client_error)' for both media PDFs.

issues.detail: The list is over 5 years old. Lewes Cabinet agreed it in June 2021 and no replacement was found. Under DMPO 2015 art. 11(3)(c), a local list item can be required only if the list was published in the 2 years before the application, so the council may not be able to rely on it for validation. Grokbot marks 'Outdated (>2y)? Yes' but still lists the items as requirements.
issues.evidence: Decision details: 'To agree the publication and use of Planning Local Validation List contained at Appendix 1 and 2' (decision 10/06/2021, effective 17/06/2021).
issues.grok_comment: The 2021 list is over 2 years old. But a replacement was drafted: the "Draft Local List of Planning Application Requirements, Lewes District Council & Eastbourne Borough Council, December 2022" exists. Whether it was adopted is unconfirmed, so "no replacement was found" overstates the case.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. A December 2022 draft joint list with Eastbourne exists, but its adoption is unconfirmed. The list in the workbook is still over 2 years old.

issues.detail: The List date 2021-06-01 comes from PDF CreationDate metadata. The Cabinet approved publication on 10 June 2021 and the decision took effect on 17 June 2021.
issues.evidence: democracy.lewes-eastbourne.gov.uk ieDecisionDetails AIId=8609: decision date 10/06/2021, effective 17/06/2021.

issues.detail: The workbook URL points to the 'Appendix' PDF, which is the numbered guidance notes with 'Justification' text (e.g. '38) Drawing Revision List Justification'), not the main list table. The table that says which supporting documents are needed and when is 'Local Validation List 2021' (media/2923). Both appendices together make up the adopted list.
issues.evidence: Cabinet report 10 June 2021: the list is in two appendices, 'Further Detail on Local Information Requirement Planning' and 'Local Validation Requirements'.

issues.detail: Grokbot put 'Employment / Economic Statement' under 'Lawful development cert' because the garbled table text contains 'LDC'. Here LDC means Lewes District Council (the 'LDC Affordable Housing Supplementary Planning Document'), not a Lawful Development Certificate.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger: 'Applications for the removal of LDC Affordable Housing Economy agricultural/forestry occupancy conditions Supplementary Planning Document CP6...'

issues.detail: Most app-type triggers are not triggers. They are either the Appendix 'Justification - To ensure...' sentence, which gives the purpose, or columns of the policy table run together. Examples: SuDS ('To ensure that the development meets the aims of not contributing to issues of localised flooding'); Contaminated Land ('To ensure that the risk from potential site contamination has been assessed'); Archaeology, Ecology, Daylight, SCI, CIL and Planning Obligations (all 'Justification' text); Affordable Housing ('CP1: Affordable Housing CP2: Housing Type, Mix and Density DM2:'); Environmental Statement (string of NPPG reference IDs). The 'when required' column in the main list table was not used.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows trigger_excerpt values, e.g. '9) Sustainable Drainage System (SuDS) Strategy Justification - To ensure that...'

issues.detail: Several rows carry text from a different requirement. 'Agricultural Land Classification / Soils' uses the 34) Soil Management Plan text. 'Telecommunications supplementary information' and 'Planning Obligations' share the 31) Planning Obligations text. 'Transport Assessment' uses the 14) Travel Plan text. 'Floor plans / Elevations' uses the daylight 45-degree test and then runs into '28) Land Contamination'. 'Validation checklist form' uses the Sustainability checklist sentence. 'Gypsy & Traveller information' uses table text about affordable housing not being met.
issues.evidence: e.g. Telecommunications trigger: 'Radiation Protection (ICNIRP). 31) Planning Obligations/Heads of Terms Justification...'

issues.detail: These triggers are cut-off fragments with no condition: Heritage Statement ('in the heritage statement.'), Landscaping ('way of landscaping plans if these are required also).'), Open space ('of proposed play space.'), Marketing/vacancy ('or the loss of employment floorspace justified.'), Waste storage ('the required waste storage and waste collection arrangements can be accommodated on the site.').

Grokbot's own excerpts give application types it then ignored. The Drawings Revision List is required for 'Section 73 applications including Variation of conditions - approved plans, Minor-Material Amendments and Non-Material Amendments', yet the 'Variation of condition s73' and 'Non-material amendment' rows say '(none)'. The Ashdown Forest 7km buffer information applies to 'any new development... (including single dwellings)', yet it appears only under Full planning and not under Outline or Reserved matters. Everything else is under Full planning as 'INFERRED' (about 30 rows).
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'All plans must be drawn to a recognised scale... Drawings Revision List... Section 73 applications including Variation of conditions - approved plans, Minor-Material Amendments and Non-Material Amendments.'

issues.detail: Requirements visible in Grokbot's own extracted text have no app-type row. (1) Viability Assessment: development where the required affordable housing will not be met, with 'A full un-redacted viability assessment' at submission. (2) Agricultural/forestry workers' dwelling justification: new or loss of agricultural/forestry workers' housing, and removal of occupancy conditions (Appendix para 20). (3) Agriculture and Forestry Diversification Plan. (4) Soil Management Plan (34): movement of top/subsoils or significant land rise or fall. It appears only mislabelled as ALC. (5) Drawings Revision List (38): S73/MMA/NMA. (6) Site Topographical Survey (42): all new dwellings and major applications. It appears only as 'site levels / sections'.
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'A full un-redacted viability assessment should be provided at the time of submission'; 'All development or loss of an agricultural or forestry workers' housing ... Agriculture and Forestry Diversification Plan'.

issues.detail: The tab_items are mostly garbled table columns and links, not requirements. Examples: 'Further information on the CIL Regulations can be found at: cture_levy For further information please see the CIL pages...'; 'Protection of Woodland Trust Guidance Agricultural Land See paragraph 36 of Appendix 1 Ashdown Forest 7km Zone DM24:'; 'Natural Environment and Landscape See paragraph 35 of Appendix 1 Planning Policy Woodland Trust Guidance...'. Only 11 tab_items were captured, against 51 claimed 'Req. items'.
issues.evidence: tab_items, Drawing / document standards and Policy-driven requirements sections.

issues.detail: The same main list PDF was read twice (media/2923 with and without '?m=1689259392683'), so tab_items are duplicated. The 'All plans must be drawn to a recognised scale...' line and the Proposed Block Plan line each appear twice; the Ashdown Forest 7km buffer text appears 4 times.

Grokbot does not say that the north of Lewes district lies in the South Downs National Park. There the SDNPA is the planning authority and uses its own validation list. Lewes DC's list applies only outside the National Park.
issues.evidence: The Apply for planning permission page has a separate 'South Downs National Park (SDNP)' section and SDNP local validation list.
issues.claude_response: Grok could not verify this, so the finding stands until someone checks it by hand.

summary: The source PDFs blocked fetching, so I could not check the contents directly. The 2021 list (Cabinet, 10 June 2021) appears to be the latest, but it is over 5 years old, which brings its legal force into question. Grokbot's excerpts show garbled table text and 'Justification' sentences used as triggers, an 'LDC' misread as Lawful Development Certificate, and S73/NMA and viability/rural-worker requirements left out.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
